profile.name: UxBus 串口协议通信组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过串口封装、发送、接收并校验 UxBus/Modbus 风格的协议报文。它主要服务于实验系统中的设备通信流程，例如设置协议标识、检查协议头、处理私有协议以及收发请求与响应数据。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component used to package, send, receive, and validate UxBus/Modbus-style protocol frames over serial links. It supports lab-system device communications such as setting protocol identifiers, checking protocol headers, handling private protocol formats, and transferring request/response data.
